title: South Tide's Run
wikitext:
[[image:South Tide's Run.jpg|thumb|South Tide's Run]]
'''South Tide's Run''' is complementary to [[North Tide's Run]], and is the name for the southwestern coast of [[Silverpine Forest]] bordering [[the Great Sea]]. Although not as famous as the northern coast, which is the site of a sunken ship and of great significance to [[tauren]] [[druid]]s, '''South Tide's Run''' used to be a popular bathing spot for the humans of Gilneas and Pyrewood.
